facts.summary: Positive open-label proof-of-concept data, but no meaningful upper-facial-line effect · Phase 1b · DMT410 in aesthetic skin conditions · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Upper facial lines - a measurement of the visible improvement of a patient’s forehead, lateral canthal, and glabellar lines did not show clinically meaningful improvement.
evidence.safety: DMT410 was generally safe and well tolerated with no adverse events reported, no withdrawals due to treatment-related adverse events, and no potential distant spread of toxin reported.
